doc.title: Nick Mondello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 19, 2022

title: The Pee Wee Marquette spoof review that took on a life of its own
summary: On the need to verify sources, he tells how his April Fool's review of a fictitious Pee Wee Marquette album appeared on Wikipedia as real and could not be removed.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: Yes. All right? So the guys from upstairs on Cameo, Fabian, Chubby Checker, right, they all wound up progressing, you know, onto the other thing. But you know if you dig a little bit and you research, and there’s something about research that I’d like to add as well in a second, if you really dig you know you find out that these are important connections and important synchronicities. Okay? The thing about research that, in today’s day and age — and I’ll make you laugh on this too, is there’s so much information out there and verifying the information, confirming the information is really critical. And just like in the book production thing you don’t want to have clams and use spell check, you want to verify what your sources are or what-have-you. So as a humorous way of showing what happens today, a number of years ago All About Jazz asked me to do a April Fool’s spoof review. So what I did was — I’ve always been a Pee Wee Marquette fan ever since I met him at Birdland, which by the way through the good graces of Jai Florada and his father and his mother, without whom I would never be here, forget about where I am. So Pee Wee Marquette, right? So I write this thing called “The

Lost Introductions of Pee Wee Marquette.” Okay? And it was a spoof. And I incorporate the Lester Young thing and the tips and the name Art Blakey, okay? Right? And All About Jazz publishes it with a number of other spoof articles on April Fool’s Day. Okay? Well a few years later I still was interested in Pee Wee of course. Whatever happened to Pee Wee? And then I found the video clip that he did with David Letterman with his Hawaii Kai outfit and all his medals and his hat and everything, and I kind of lost — there isn’t much about him after that. But anyway I’m on Wikipedia and there on Wikipedia there is a CD album called “The Lost Introductions of Pee Wee Marquette.”

Yeah. So dig this: so I get in touch with Wikipedia and I write them and I say it was a spoof, it’s presented as a spoof, please, you know you don’t want to have erroneous information on Wikipedia. Okay? Please remove it. They wouldn’t remove it. About six months later I get an email from someone I think in India who writes me and says, “Can you provide me the CD?” So it just took on a life of its own. Okay.
Yeah. It’s out there and you can’t stop it.
